invariants.assertion: H equals one active P or U per stable duty, independent of cut hashes or executor phases; unique natural slot and CAS prevent duplication; N cannot offset.

Receiver cash and N removal commit together; N never enters prior cash, risk collateral, borrow pool or admission availability.
Per-currency journal balances and complete original leg/treasury/clearing references reconcile; no capital is minted.
One immutable duty has at most one APPLIED receipt and each customer leg posts once; retry, lease and ownership changes never duplicate effects.
Every accepted implemented new-risk operation has a complete exact historical funding basis and durable reservation under serialized account/funding versions.
No state/claim expiry/cancel request/restart/data gap releases a fixed unpaid P; unknown basis cannot be treated as zero.
Pending liabilities/receivables, credit principal/interest, cash deficits, fees, spot locks and order reserve remain separately auditable with each monetary effect counted once.
Historical replay reconstructs state only through original watermark and exact source/policy/market/evaluation time, never from present task status.
Funding never commits cash that violates remaining real frozen backing or skips prior confirmed settlement; waiting retains debt/H/N and truthful unpaid status.
Required first-wait deadline/query budget survive restart/claims; expiry produces durable review/escalation without debt waiver or false APPLIED.
P/N are recognized exactly once in accrual, U is not payable and H is not a second accounting liability; cash settlement and obligation removal are atomic.

test_gates.title: Gross P/U/N and duplicate identity
test_gates.acceptance: Two or more debits sum gross; receivers never increase pre-commit risk credit; each exact economic identity contributes once.

test_gates.title: Per-period per-account minor units and real rounding capital
test_gates.acceptance: Independent integer/rational oracle matches original toward-zero leg units, waiver and real capital postings; no cross-period merge, split, dust carry or minted money.

test_gates.title: Cut plus hold plus restriction atomicity
test_gates.acceptance: Fault before/after each write yields no partial cut/hold; complete cut remains recorded even if effective equity is negative; due boundary keeps new risk closed if commit fails.

test_gates.title: Complete due-period inventory and temporal ownership
test_gates.acceptance: Missing task, delayed timer, unsettled prior confirmed fill, clock rollback, orphan or paginated omission blocks new risk; before/after-boundary trades use the proper frozen quantity and event watermark.

test_gates.title: Order/modify/trigger/batch/auto-borrow shared admission
test_gates.acceptance: Multiple commands against one remaining budget cannot both spend it; not implemented operations reject before state/capability effects. Orders include fees, slippage, pending cancellation and overlap.

test_gates.title: Funding-aware quote and no implicit Credit V2 activation
test_gates.acceptance: Recompute quote with H headroom and strict MM; stale base quote rejects. Actual loan pool, limits and post-state remain independent; old Credit V2 installer and borrow reject new contract before effects until separately upgraded.

test_gates.title: Withdrawal/transfer/native currency handoff
test_gates.acceptance: Cash budget and projected account risk both checked once; source/destination isolation and exactly-once transaction/authorization hold. Unsupported custody or transfer adapters reject before financial effects.

test_gates.title: Collateral removal and non-USD tiers
test_gates.acceptance: Revalue whole projected inventory; do not lock fictional BTC for USD funding or double-count H/spot/order locks; asset eligibility removal and non-USD debits use the same basis.

test_gates.title: Own hold cannot block confirmed cash and atomic consumption
test_gates.acceptance: All local period cash/capital/clearing/postings/hold transitions/receipt/APPLIED/version commit together. Negative cash is recorded; other task holds remain. Effective risk continuity holds at fixed market and unchanged unrelated state. Mandatory debit also requires real backing and closed prior confirmed obligations per PFH-T027/T028; negative cash only without frozen backing violation.

test_gates.title: Missing current quote versus damaged cash authority
test_gates.acceptance: Trusted fixed USD cash applies with restricted-risk/recheck event when only current risk data is missing; no false fresh-risk success. Unknown/damaged cut/reference authority retains holds and recovers known-good artifact, with no engine/policy fallback. Missing quotes never bypass real frozen backing or the prior-confirmed-fill barrier.

test_gates.title: Lease expiry, generations and duplicate results
test_gates.acceptance: Stale claimant cannot mutate; reclaim never duplicates or releases holds. WAITING/REVIEW states retain H; result unknown queries original ID; duplicate same content replays original result, changed content conflicts.

test_gates.title: Principal/interest/fees/cash deficits remain gross
test_gates.acceptance: No debt netting, invented principal, loan interest on funding, repeated fee, or H retained after cash debit. Independent per-currency accounting and explicit accrual view reconcile.

test_gates.title: Fixed-exposure cap and resolution replacement
test_gates.acceptance: Exact ceiling minor-unit cap replaces atomically with final toward-zero P/N, including zero and sign change; missing bounds/cut/rate outside cap reject new risk and preserve prior holds, never rate0 fallback.

test_gates.title: Under-reserved existing orders
test_gates.acceptance: Freeze before new admission; retain unacknowledged reserve; partial fills and cancel acknowledgements update only confirmed quantities. No NORMAL supervisor state silently clears funding restriction.

test_gates.title: MM equality, negative equity and residual debt
test_gates.acceptance: Fund-aware E<=MM triggers durable distress; real candidates include fees/slippage and fixed unpaid cuts, closure does not erase old funding. No liquidity remains blocked; no invented execution, insurance payment or ADL.

test_gates.title: Version, unsupported products and operation rejection
test_gates.acceptance: Unknown/duplicate fields, bool versions, wrong generation, missing capability, unsupported mode/settlement/worker/shard/credit/custody reject before financial/capability writes. Default legacy paths do not silently gain this behavior.

test_gates.title: Immutable debt, cancellation and compensation
test_gates.acceptance: No post-cut delete/void/edit, no release on request/review. Compensation capability remains rejected until separately reviewed; its future debits add H, credits do not net before APPLIED.

test_gates.title: Exact funding basis and event-time replay
test_gates.acceptance: Replay uses complete archived entries as of recorded event watermark and exact code/policy/market/time; current APPLIED state cannot alter historical H. Reconcile active holds versus cut/receipt/journal after reopen.

test_gates.title: All financial entrypoints and frozen recovery
test_gates.acceptance: Pinned old binaries, constructors/openers/direct service/credit/spot/matching/managed/takeover entrypoints cannot write the new authority. Read-only open causes no DDL/repair/cap creation. Customer, treasury, risk unlock and correction permissions stay separate.

test_gates.title: Unknown commit, disk full and recovery
test_gates.acceptance: Kill/fault each financial boundary, disk-full/archive-full/store-unavailable/response-lost, reopen and reconcile. No lost duty, duplicate posting, released in-flight hold or silently resumed risk; do not infer HA/RPO from single-host evidence.

test_gates.title: Enumerate concurrency and crash states
test_gates.acceptance: Independent model with two accounts, two tasks, two orders and two competing claimants plus one serialized authority writer checks invariants for capture/resolve/admit/cancel/fill/apply/retry/expiry/crash. Transaction commit atomicity and immutable exact authority are explicit assumptions, not proven replication properties.

test_gates.title: Bounded complete aggregation and control-plane liveness
test_gates.acceptance: Existing task<=1000/participant<=1000/command<=10000/archive<=1MiB or new reviewed bounds enforced without silent truncation/hold eviction. Reserve cancellation, repayment and mandatory settlement capacity; quota failure keeps restrictions durable.

test_gates.title: Four-side trade link plus funding basis
test_gates.acceptance: Independent matcher confirms trades and receipts; orders/trades/positions/ledger and archived funding basis reconcile across partial fills, cancellations, liquidation, restart and negative cash. Mark-price generated fills remain labelled tests.

test_gates.title: Mixed 10k durable order and 10k complete liquidation fills
test_gates.acceptance: Separate pure/adapter/SQL/matching/queue costs; same declared hardware/shards/storage/replication/liquidity/account skew, >=30min plus soak, mixed/double burst/hotspot/stale quote/depeg/thin book/faults. Planned-arrival P50/P95/P99/P99.9, unique successful ledger+position-committed fills, all result classes and reopened reconciliation; no split-fill inflation.
Pure canonical ID before schedule, exact UTC/types and scalar bounds; cut/claim/command changes retain ID; natural-slot uniqueness rejects alternate interval/rule scope/obligation IDs.

Independent model enumerates U-to-P/N/zero, stale CAS/double resolver/changed command/crash/replay; one duty and one active representation, immutable old refs retained, no transient missing or duplicate H.

cash100/F95/P12 commits WAIT plus restriction/outbox but no cash or hold release; true cancellation10 yields F85; recheck then pay88/P0 with effective risk3. F0 negative-cash cases remain valid; no frozen<=gross weakening.

Process confirmed fill/fees under original authority before funding. Incomplete CANCELLED reply or unknown fill watermark cannot release locks; actual proof consumes allocation exactly once and reprices risk at latest versions.

Required exact typed wait parameters, fixed first-wait deadline, bounded queries and no restart/claim extension; deadline or budget exhaustion writes DEFAULT_REVIEW preserving debt and restriction. Late ack cannot automatically unlock.

Bounded crash/unknown-result model covers wait+outbox commit, external cancel before durable ack, ack before payment, version race and cash commit response loss; old action IDs queried, no fake acknowledgement, release or repeat cash.
